chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talqani (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Abdul Aziz ibn Yahya al-Jolodi in Basra narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Aban narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Salama, from Zayd ibn al-Harith, from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Layla,
He said: Eighty verses were revealed regarding Ali (peace be upon him) consecutively in the Book of God, the Exalted, with no one else from this nation sharing in them.

key_terms.مَا شَرِكَهُ فِيهَا: With no one else sharing in them

ai.seo_question: Which eighty verses of the Quran were revealed specifically for Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* asserts that eighty consecutive verses were revealed exclusively regarding Imam Ali (peace be upon him), a claim central to Shia exegetical tradition for establishing his unique spiritual and political authority. While Sunni scholars often debate the specific identity of these verses, Shia scholars view this as definitive proof of the *Imamah* and the distinct status of the Ahl al-Bayt within the Quranic narrative. The exclusivity emphasized in the text underscores the belief that no other companion shared in this specific divine designation.
